 News › News News › School holiday tomorrow, october 22: Check state-wise dussehra holidays and november 2026 list School holiday tomorrow, october 22: Check state-wise dussehra holidays and november 2026 list
 Sajid Raza Published: Oct 21, 2026, 18:18 IST Updated: Oct 21, 2026, 18:18 IST School Holiday, October 22: Check State-Wise Dussehra Holidays and November 2026 Holiday List Schools across India may follow different holiday schedules on Thursday, October 22, 2026, as Dussehra and Durga Puja vacations continue in some states. Dussehra, also known as Vijayadashami, was observed on October 20 this year in most parts of India.
 While some schools are scheduled to reopen after the festive break, others may remain closed according to their state’s academic calendar.
 There is no nationwide order confirming a school holiday on October 22. According to reported vacation schedules, schools in Andhra Pradesh are expected to reopen on October 22, while schools in Telangana may remain closed until October 22 and reopen on October 23. Schools in Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal may also follow extended autumn or Durga Puja vacations. 
 Students and parents should check their school’s latest notice for confirmation.
 Meanwhile, students are also looking for the November 2026 school holiday list, which includes major festivals such as Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti. However, the exact dates of school closures may vary by state, district and institution. Parents are advised to check official school calendars before making plans.
 State-Wise Dussehra School Holidays 2026 
 The following table summarises the reported Dussehra and autumn vacation schedules in selected states.
 State/Region Reported school holiday schedule Expected reopening 
 Uttar Pradesh October 18–25 October 26 
 Delhi-NCR October 18–20 October 21, subject to the school calendar 
 Bihar October 17–21 October 22 
 Jharkhand October 19–21 October 22 
 Andhra Pradesh October 10–21 October 22 
 Telangana October 10–22 October 23 
 West Bengal October 15–26 October 27 
 Kerala Holiday on October 19 for Durga Ashtami; other dates depend on the school calendar As per the school calendar 
 Uttar Pradesh School Holiday Update 
 Schools in Uttar Pradesh may remain closed through October 25 as part of the autumn break. If the reported schedule is followed, classes may resume on Monday, October 26.
 However, parents should check their school’s official notification for confirmation, particularly if the institution follows a separate academic calendar.
 Delhi-NCR School Holiday Update 
 Schools in Delhi-NCR had a reported holiday schedule covering October 18 to October 20, including the festive period around Dussehra. October 22 is not automatically a school holiday for all institutions in the region.
 Students should confirm whether their school has announced any extension of the festive break.
 Bihar and Jharkhand School Holiday Update 
 Bihar schools had a reported Dussehra vacation from October 17 to October 21, while schools in Jharkhand had a shorter break from October 19 to October 21.
 Under these schedules, schools may reopen on October 22. Any district-level order or school-specific announcement will take precedence.
 Andhra Pradesh and Telangana School Holiday Update 
 Andhra Pradesh and Telangana have longer Dussehra vacation schedules than many other states.
 Andhra Pradesh schools are expected to reopen on October 22 after the reported break from October 10 to October 21. Telangana schools may remain closed through October 22, with classes expected to resume on October 23.
 Students should verify the reopening dates with their respective schools.
 West Bengal School Holiday Update 
 Schools in West Bengal may continue their Durga Puja and autumn vacations through October 26. Under the reported schedule, classes could resume on October 27.
 The holiday period may vary between government, government-aided and private institutions.
 November 2026 School Holiday List: Important Dates 
 November 2026 will include several religious festivals and regional holidays. Diwali will fall on Sunday, November 8, followed by Govardhan Puja on November 9 in calendars that observe the festival on that date. 
 Bhai Dooj and Chhath Puja will also be observed during the month.
 Here is a list of important dates that students and parents should know.
 Date Day Festival or occasion Holiday details 
 November 1, 2026 Sunday Kannada Rajyotsava, Haryana Day and other regional observances State-specific; Sunday 
 November 8, 2026 Sunday Diwali (Deepavali) Major festival; falls on Sunday 
 November 9, 2026 Monday Govardhan Puja Observed as a holiday in some states and schools 
 November 11, 2026 Wednesday Bhai Dooj Holiday in some regional calendars 
 November 15, 2026 Sunday Chhath Puja Important festival in Bihar and other regions 
 November 24, 2026 Tuesday Guru Nanak Jayanti Major holiday in several states 
 November 27, 2026 Friday Kanakadasa Jayanti Regional holiday in Karnataka 
 The list includes major festivals and selected regional observances. It is not a complete list of holidays for every state. November 27 and other regional dates should be checked against the applicable state calendar.
